scoring_justification: Exact reference DBAR ratio and MDB differential curves cannot be embedded as gold numeric tables; derived structural properties (low-momentum ratio peak, high-momentum convergence, monotonic decrease, peak sign/location, tail near zero) are scored instead.

schema.description: One column 'momentum' (float, unit m₀c) and one column 'ratio' (float).

outputs.description: DBAR ratio spectrum N(p)/N_ref(p) of the V12 vacancy cluster. The verifier compares intensity values against hidden reference data using a tolerance‑based metric.

schema.description: One column 'momentum' (float, unit m₀c) and one column 'differential_intensity' (float).

outputs.description: MDB differential spectrum N+(p) − N−(p) of the V12 cluster. The verifier compares intensity values against hidden reference data using a tolerance‑based metric.

schema.description: A single floating‑point number representing the total magnetization of the double‑V12 supercell.

outputs.description: Spontaneous magnetization of the double-V12 supercell. The verifier checks the agent’s value against a hidden reference within a small tolerance.

output_contract.notes: All outputs are required. The DBAR and MDB curves must cover the momentum range 0 to ~20×10⁻³ m₀c with sufficient resolution (~0.1×10⁻³ m₀c). Hidden reference values are derived from the published theoretical curves.
